mandate: C432 — test the price-only EDF-GOODNESS-OF-FIT normality-departure stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0); m[t]=mean_i r_i[t] (equal-weight market return). Causal trailing mean μ[t] and std σ[t] of {r[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128). Standardized return z[t]=(r[t]-μ[t])/σ[t] (z[t]=0 if σ[t]≤0 or non-finite). Per trailing window of z: order statistics z_(1)≤...≤z_(n), p_(i)=Φ(z_(i)) vs N(0,1). Anderson–Darling A² = -n - (1/n)Σ(2i-1)[ln(p_(i))+ln(1-p_(n+1-i))]; Cramér–von Mises W² = 1/(12n) + Σ(p_(i)-(2i-1)/(2n))²; Kolmogorov–Smirnov D = max_i max(|p_(i)-i/n|, |p_(i)-(i-1)/n|); Kuiper V = D⁺ + D⁻. NaN if t<W_q or any NaN/non-finite in window or σ[t]≤0 or any p∈{0,1}. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (edf_ad_dev, edf_cvm_dev, edf_ks_dev, edf_kuiper_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates of the real return-derived EDF-GOF series, never market data, never fabricated). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W_q or σ[t]≤0 or p∈{0,1} or NaN in trailing window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0).
methodology.primitives: causal trailing mean/std μ[t], σ[t] of {r[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128); standardized return z[t]=(r[t]-μ[t])/σ[t]; order statistics z_(1)≤...≤z_(n), p_(i)=Φ(z_(i)); Anderson–Darling A², Cramér–von Mises W², Kolmogorov–Smirnov D, Kuiper V vs N(0,1); concepts edf_ad/edf_cvm/edf_ks/edf_kuiper.
methodology.signals: edf_ad_dev/edf_cvm_dev/edf_ks_dev/edf_kuiper_dev plus phase-randomized-surrogate placebos over W_q=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal of the real return-derived EDF-GOF series; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment; never market data, never fabricated.
methodology.edf_vectorization_note: rolling mean/std via cumulative sums O(N); sorted trailing windows of z via vectorized sliding sort; EDF statistics via cumulative-sum identities over the sorted order statistics, O(N log N) per asset per concept; validated against a naive per-window EDF-GOF reference with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
